scope: Combined phone-upload recovery and field-confirmation review. Inline execution and review.

implementation.backendStorageErrors: Explicit HTTP/provider-code classification; no false expiry for service errors; invalid markers fail closed as internal errors.
implementation.confirmation: Immutable completion manifest with atomic create; identical repeats recover partial marker writes; changed count/orders remain conflicts.
implementation.cancellation: Recheck before completion; update existing session objects instead of recreating deleted markers.
implementation.clientRecovery: One shared helper; preparation and confirmation only; three transient attempts within 30 seconds; 10-second request limits; existing eight-call settling loop.
implementation.userState: Photos retained; metadata-only confirmation retry; busy controls released; Retry-After gates manual retry.
implementation.fieldConfirmation: Other thread fix retained and reviewed. Foreground observation uses timers; real field mismatch alerts retain booleans/lengths without field text; user edits remain untouched.

healthyPhoneMeasurements.fixture: Two photos, 2ms simulated delay per storage call. Local measurements, not production latency.

healthyFieldMeasurements.fixture: Matching visible fields in isolated Chromium. No live marketplace or generation.
